rules.name: Repeated SSH failures
rules.description: One source IP produces five failed SSH logins within five minutes.
rules.alert_reason: Repeated SSH password failures indicate brute-force activity.
rules.possible_impact: Credential guessing may lead to account compromise.
recommended_response: Restrict or block the source IP after approval

rules.name: Username enumeration
rules.description: One source IP attempts five distinct invalid usernames within ten minutes.
rules.alert_reason: Multiple invalid usernames indicate account discovery.
rules.possible_impact: Attacker may identify valid accounts for later compromise.

rules.name: Successful login after repeated failures
rules.description: A source IP authenticates after failures in the prior thirty minutes.
rules.alert_reason: A login succeeded after repeated failures from the same source.

rules.name: Unusual-hours password login
rules.description: Successful password login between midnight and 05:00.
rules.alert_reason: Password authentication occurred during unusual hours.

rules.name: Newly created account login
rules.description: A newly created account authenticates during the same investigation.
rules.alert_reason: A new local account was later used for access.

rules.name: Local account created
rules.description: A local user account was created.

rules.name: Root shell obtained
rules.alert_reason: Root shell or root sudo session observed.

rules.name: Privileged-group modification
rules.description: User was added to sudo, wheel, admin, or root-equivalent group.

rules.name: Sudoers modification
rules.alert_reason: Sudoers modification can grant passwordless root.

rules.name: Remote script piped to shell
rules.description: Command downloads and pipes content to a shell.
rules.alert_reason: Remote script execution pattern detected in logs.
